controls.detail: Current order sizing uses the configured share of deployable buying power for a single option idea, subject to contract-price math and the AGENT_OPTION_ORDER_QTY baseline.
controls.label: Max risk per trade
controls.value: 45% of deployable buying power (~29.25% of total buying power)

controls.detail: Hard ceiling on the premium of one new entry. The order is shrunk to fit, and rejected outright when a single contract already costs more than the allowance.
controls.label: Premium cap per trade
controls.value: 55% of account buying power or $1,500, whichever is tighter

controls.detail: New entries in one underlying are rejected once the rolling attempt cap is reached, or while the post-stop-loss cooldown for that underlying is still active.
controls.label: Per-symbol entry limits

controls.detail: New entries are rejected once the broker reports the configured portfolio-wide option-position count. Each accepted idea remains subject to the configured per-idea quantity multiplier.
controls.label: Max open contracts
controls.value: 5 open positions; base qty 1, up to x100 per idea

controls.detail: The execution loop stops adding new option orders once the configured deployable buying power allowance is consumed.
controls.label: Max total options exposure

controls.detail: New entries are rejected when their persisted company sector would exceed this share of the total option-notional cap.
controls.label: Sector concentration cap

controls.detail: New entries are rejected after persisted broker-confirmed option losses for the current market day reach this limit.
controls.label: Daily realized-loss limit

controls.detail: Open option positions use DTE-specific stop-loss floors. Positions outside those DTE buckets fall back to the legacy defaults (45% TP / -35% SL / 75h expiration exit).
controls.label: Stop-loss rule

controls.detail: Open option positions use DTE-specific take-profit targets. Positions outside those DTE buckets fall back to the legacy defaults (45% TP / -35% SL / 75h expiration exit).
controls.label: Take-profit rule

controls.detail: The option manager uses DTE-specific forced exits before expiration. Positions outside those DTE buckets fall back to the legacy defaults (45% TP / -35% SL / 75h expiration exit).
controls.label: Expiration exit rule
